title: SM DC2C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine DC2C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 9 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} sets the regulator gain, {Regulator time constant, T_A (s)}, {Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)}, {Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)}, {Maximum controller output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the controller output upper limit, {Minimum controller output, V_Rmin (pu)} sets the controller output lower limit, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the overexcitation limiter input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the underexcitation limiter input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the stator current limiter input location, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Lower limit, E_FDmin (pu)} sets the field voltage lower limit, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} sets the first saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} sets the first saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} sets the second saturation output voltage and {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} sets the second saturation lookup voltage. Values come from the instance.
